context: Tests whether the agent implements UC-010 (Browse Product Catalog) end-to-end for a FLAT single-module backend following the implement skill's Pattern B: a JPA entity mapped onto the existing schema, a Spring Data JPA repository, a service enforcing BR-010, a REST controller returning a DTO (not the entity), and an Angular standalone component using signals and HttpClient. No test files should be created. This is the flat-fallback regression check, run alongside the hexagonal-aware scenario-1.

checklist.name: Product JPA entity created
checklist.description: A Product class annotated @Entity is created, mapped onto the existing product table (fields for id, name, category, price, inStock matching the migration's columns via default Hibernate naming)

checklist.name: Spring Data JPA repository created
checklist.description: A ProductRepository interface extends JpaRepository (or CrudRepository) for the Product entity

checklist.name: Service class enforces BR-010
checklist.description: A service class contains the query/filter logic that excludes inStock = false products regardless of the category filter applied, matching business rule BR-010

checklist.name: Controller returns a DTO, not the entity
checklist.description: The @RestController method(s) return a DTO/record type rather than the Product @Entity directly

checklist.name: REST endpoint exposed
checklist.description: A @RestController class exposes a GET endpoint (e.g. under /api/products) returning the product list as JSON, with an optional category filter

checklist.name: Did not fabricate a hexagonal module split
checklist.description: The agent did not create separate domain/business/postgres/api Maven modules for this flat single-module project — all backend code stays in the single existing module

checklist.name: Angular component uses signals
checklist.description: The ProductCatalog component uses signal() for state (e.g. products, isLoading, category filter) rather than plain fields or a store library

checklist.name: Standalone component, no NgModule
checklist.description: No NgModule is created; the component remains a standalone component

checklist.name: Hand-written HttpClient service
checklist.description: A hand-written service using HttpClient (inject or constructor DI) calls the new backend endpoint; no generated OpenAPI client, no NgRx

checklist.name: Category filter dropdown in the UI
checklist.description: The component renders a category filter control (e.g. a select) that narrows the displayed products, matching alternative flow A1

checklist.name: No test files created
checklist.description: No test classes (Java) or spec files (*.spec.ts) are created as part of this task
